Step 1: Start date: 1654-05 (May 1654).  
Step 2: Add 41 years: 1654 + 41 = 1695, still May.  
Step 3: Add 1 month: May → June 1695.  
Step 4: No day given, so assume same day of month (if 1st of May → 1st of June).  
Final date: 1695-06 (same day as start, but only month/year needed for answer).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1695-06
